name: EISC pair: A
description: Half of a pair of programs that talk over an EISC (IP ID 10). A toggle, a slider and a text send go to B; what B sends back shows on the panel. Load it with EISC pair B in another slot, or on another machine and link them with a remote EISC link (Labs).
panel: XPanel at IP ID 03; EISC at IP ID 10
tryIt: Press digital 1 to toggle, move analog 1, press digital 2 to send text to B. Digital 2 and analog 1 on this panel follow B's digital 1 and analog 1.
